answer_1.quote: Embedding personality traits into LLMs can greatly enhance their authenticity across a wide range of applications, from conversational agents to educational tools and mental health platforms... Our results demonstrate that both SFT and DPO outperform prompting on two widely recognized Big Five personality tests...
answer_1.outputs: dialogue responses conditioned on Big Five personality traits

answer_2.quote: Using the classifier as an evaluator, we demonstrate the high quality of the dataset generated by our expert generator... The classifier was used to evaluate the generated data by predicting the levels of each trait, and the quality was measured by whether the predictions matched the desired personality traits.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation to assess the realism and validity of BIG5-CHAT... Two graduate students... were tasked with comparing examples... The evaluation focused on two key metrics: 1. Expressiveness of personality traits and levels...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compared responses from BIG5-CHAT against baseline outputs, choosing which system's generation was better, equal, or worse based on specified metrics.
